edges.notes: Helm applies charts to a cluster via the Kubernetes API; upstream Helm is defined around Kubernetes targets.
Helm supports OCI-based chart registries (registry push/pull) using distribution-class HTTP semantics.
Chart templates commonly reference workload container images that are pulled as OCI images per workload values.
Developer workflows often combine Docker-built images with Helm-deployed charts (survey-level).
Flux helm-controller reconciles HelmRepository and HelmRelease resources on the cluster.
Argo CD can deploy workloads from Helm chart sources per upstream Application source types.
Helm supports Kustomize as a post-renderer for rendered chart output in documented workflows.
